en: This postcard features a historical black-and-white photograph of a neoclassical theater building seen behind a row of mature trees. In the foreground, several people are seated on benches, giving the scene a leisurely air. The building in the image is identified as 'Bad Pyrmont. Fürstl. Theater.' On the reverse side, there is a handwritten message, address section, a German stamp from the Deutsches Reich era, and the printed text 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont.' It is addressed to Berlin.
